arguments.sql: WITH RECURSIVE hours(h) AS (SELECT 0 UNION ALL SELECT h + 1 FROM hours WHERE h < 23), counts AS (SELECT CAST(strftime('%H', date) AS INTEGER) AS h, COUNT(*) AS n FROM transactions GROUP BY 1) SELECT hours.h AS hour_of_day, COALESCE(counts.n, 0) AS transaction_count FROM hours LEFT JOIN counts ON counts.h = hours.h ORDER BY hours.h
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions by the hour of the day they happened, with one row for each hour from 0 to 23. An hour with no transactions shows a count of zero.
assumptions: Counted all transactions in the data (2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31), whether or not they have a fraud label, any error or a negative amount.
Took the hour from the transaction timestamp as recorded, with no time zone conversion.
